name: VEX
description: A blazing-fast incremental build system in Rust — hashes file contents not timestamps, skips unchanged tasks, and ships a remote cache server for shared CI builds.

name: nuerosim
description: NeuroSim: A production-grade computational neuroscience platform for large-scale brain simulation. Features biophysically accurate Hodgkin-Huxley neuron models, multi-compartment cable equations, synaptic plasticity, E-I network dynamics, RK4 integration, MPI/CUDA HPC support, and an interactive Plotly Dash visualization dashboard.

name: repopilot
description: RepoPilot is an autonomous AI agent that analyzes code repositories, modifies files, executes tests, and iteratively fixes errors until the system passes — all through a self-correcting execution loop.

name: FluxCore
description: Event-driven orchestration engine for distributed workflows and autonomous automation systems.

name: PulseStack
description: Open-source observability and runtime intelligence platform for distributed AI workflows, autonomous agents, and automation systems.

name: AgentWatch
description: AgentWatch — Real-time reasoning auditor and observability platform for AI agents. Catches silent failures in your agent's reasoning chain before they execute — not after they break production.

name: SentinelCV
description: Plug-and-play real-time vision AI for fall detection and safety monitoring across CCTV and IP cameras.

name: ATLAS
description: Experimental geometry-aware retrieval and local compute-to-data, with reproducible evaluation and explicit evidence limits.

name: MEOWCODE
description: Meow Code is a privacy-first, unified AI workspace where authorized AI providers become interchangeable workers behind one persistent project, memory, tool, connector, agent, and workflow layer.

name: quantum-advantage-simulator
description: The project studies how exact simulation, neural quantum states, variational quantum algorithms, noise mitigation, and automated circuit search behave under the same reproducible benchmark framework.

name: robust-reasoning-rl
description: A Python research framework for studying whether reasoning policies optimize correctness or exploit noisy, incomplete, biased, and inconsistent verifier rewards. It implements shared TRL GRPO training paths, uncertainty-aware reward shaping, independent evaluation, and controlled corruption sweeps with complete per-generation records.
